name: OMDb
author: Chronicle Contributors
description: Movie, series and episode metadata from OMDb by IMDb id: full plots, posters, runtimes, cast and crew, and ratings from IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic. Needs a free OMDb API key (omdbapi.com/apikey.aspx, 1,000 requests a day). Fills what other sources lack, especially TV episodes.
fixMatchHint: Enter an IMDb id (tt0133093), an imdb.com title URL, or an id with its prefix (imdb:tt0133093 or omdb:tt0133093).

background_tasks.description: Looks up OMDb metadata, by IMDb id, for movies, shows and episodes that have not been enriched by OMDb yet. The free key allows 1,000 requests a day; when it runs out the rest waits for the next run.
Re-fetches all OMDb metadata to pick up new plots, posters and ratings. Uses a request per item, so a large library takes several days on the free key.
